text.title: Quit Day Job Trigger Contract Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals from the contract and the provider's MRR report to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml for quit-day-job-trigger-contract. Walk it at every review.

decision-tree.root-question: Is this a solo SaaS builder on a $0 to $4k MRR bootstrap with a billing-provider MRR report, a runway model, and a version-controlled place for the contract?

branch.when: solo_bootstrap == false OR provider_mrr_report == false OR runway_model == false OR versioned_store == false

conclusion.verdict: skip; without a provider MRR report and a runway model there is nothing to trigger on

branch.when: solo_bootstrap == true AND provider_mrr_report == true AND runway_model == true AND versioned_store == true
branch.question: Is the metric net MRR from the named provider report, with the window set to N >= 3 consecutive month-ends?

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK; pin the metric to the provider's net MRR report
BLOCK; set N to at least 3 consecutive month-ends

branch.question: Is runway >= R months a stated co-condition, and is the reversal threshold strictly below the trigger with a window of at least 2 months?

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK; add the runway floor with burn including tax, insurance and business costs
BLOCK; lower the reversal threshold and widen its window

branch.when: runway_co_condition == true AND reversal_threshold < trigger_threshold AND reversal_window_months >= 2
branch.question: Was version 1.0.0 committed before the first qualifying month-end, with no parameter change inside the current window?

conclusion.verdict: revert in-window changes; label a late contract post_hoc and treat its first window as void
APPROVE; contract is live, record the month-end readings and gate values at each review

text.example: Solo builder, Stripe MRR report, runway model in repo → metric = Stripe net MRR, N = 3 → runway floor 12 months stated, reversal $3,000 for 2 months below trigger $4,000 → v1.0.0 committed 2026-02-01, first qualifying month-end 2026-05-31 → APPROVE → quarterly review records readings 4,150 / 4,300 / 4,420, runway 13.1 months, top customer 11%, churn 2.8% → verdict `fired`.
